title: a menu that opens on mouseenter opens for a reader's pointer resting on it

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
a resting pointer opens the menu

interaction.reason: pointer moves are never streamed and nothing watches for a dwell, so a JS mouseenter menu opens only through the context menu's explicit Hover-here entry — a gesture no reader discovers

style.reason: the reader's pointer rests on #products, so the mirror wears its :hover background; the landside pointer was never sent there, so the real page does not

notes: the pointer is deliberately left resting on #products through the final probe: hover is state, and the state the reader sees diverging from the state the page has is exactly the measurement
